title: Localized Vector Modes on Local Cosmic Strings
summary: We investigate the dynamics of vector excitations localized on cosmic strings in the Abelian-Higgs model. These confined gauge field fluctuations behave as massive vector degrees of freedom propagating along the string. We show that they remain bounded for all values of the scalar self coupling $λ$, including parameter regimes in which the previously studied conventional shape mode is no longer present.
